cases.name: Elizabeth Lorene Schalchlin
cases.about: Her obituary said she "was a beautiful, bright, charming teen-ager who enjoyed talking with friends, had a passion for baton, and had been selected for the national baton competition. She loved baton she had recently moved up to three batons, and had earned many medals. She had also worked extensively with flag and rifle. She was always able to see the brighter side of things and she loved to laugh."
cases.narrative: Her brother's friend grabbed a kitchen knife and slit her throat while she talked on the phone.

cases.name: Ellen Lorene “Lori” Estes Schalchlin
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Lori was a protector of the weak and needy, opening her home and her life to those less fortunate than herself, both human and animal. She provided a home and care for injured animals, nursing them back to health, before releasing them."
cases.narrative: Her son's friend stabbed her 86 times as she pled with her son 15-year-old Donald to help her.
